name: Binvox File Parsing
definition: Parses the binvox binary voxel format, reading a fixed header (version, dimensions) and run-length encoded voxel data into a contiguous unsigned char array.
summary: Binvox File Parsing imports binary voxel files by decompressing legacy run-length encoded data into flat arrays or Sparse Voxel Octrees, distinguishing itself through specific handling of compact binary RLE schemes.
